items.text: Minnesota RB Aaron Jones Sr. aggravated his left knee (MCL) in Week 7 but avoided a serious injury; Kevin O'Connell calls him day-to-day. Jordan Mason (back from a thumb fracture) is the fill-in.

Detroit WR Amon-Ra St. Brown tweaked an ankle and CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (ankle) left Week 7; Dan Campbell doesn't think either is serious but a return is 'not guaranteed.' RB Jahmyr Gibbs 'should be good.'
